narrative: 经典的吸烟-肺癌因果研究。抽烟会沉积焦油，焦油在肺部增加肿瘤风险。但是否抽烟本身和肺癌之间还有未观测的遗传 / 生活习惯共因——我们测不到。数据集里我们观察到吸烟（二值）、焦油沉积（二值阳性/阴性）和肺癌诊断（二值）。
question: 基于这个观察性数据，抽烟对肺癌风险的平均因果效应是多少？

gold_edges.source_span: 焦油在肺部增加肿瘤风险
未观测的遗传 / 生活习惯共因

must_not_infer.reason: Narrative explicitly routes the effect through tar; a direct smoking→cancer edge would break the front-door criterion (tar would no longer intercept all directed paths)

gold_numeric_estimate.dgp_description: U ~ Normal(0, 1); smoking ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(U)); tar ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(2*smoking - 1)); cancer ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(2*tar + 2*U - 2)); front-door ATE via Pearl 3.29 ≈ 0.127 on this DGP (calibrated via n=100000 front-door estimation).
